_meta.units: SVG user units, 720 per inch; pct_of_min_dim = units / min(viewBox W, H) * 100
_meta.method: x = 1..20, y1 = 1 + 0.5*mod(_n,2) + 0.02*_n, y2 = y1 + 4, y3 = y1 + 8; scatter, line and connected of y1-y3 on x and twoway histogram mpg of auto, under each scheme, exported to SVG and read by scripts/svg_scheme_visual.py
